prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1332; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a third party vehicle that entered on a red signal per the insured's account. Police report requested. Tow and rental arranged for insured.

Entry 2: Third party carrier acknowledged liability position is under review. Scene photos and dashcam footage received from insured. Signal timing records requested from the municipality. Claimant reports left knee injury and has retained counsel. All further contact to be routed through attorney of record.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding medical authorization forms and treatment records. Attorney indicates claimant has been referred for orthopedic evaluation and possible MRI of the left knee. Requested itemized bills and prior medical history for the same body part. Reserve set pending medical documentation.

Entry 4: Reviewed police report, which notes disputed signal phase and two independent witness statements. Witness statements suggest the third party vehicle did not stop. Vehicle damage estimate completed on insured unit, with structural and door intrusion noted. Liability assessment leaning toward third party, pending signal timing confirmation.

Entry 5: Attorney submitted demand package including initial treatment notes, physical therapy progress reports, and a request for policy limits review. Demand is under evaluation with medical review scheduled. Advised attorney we will respond within the standard timeframe after records are reviewed. File remains open with injury and liability both active.
